view: Frontal chest radiograph (PA projection, erect), L marker at image upper right confirming conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Suboptimal: low lung volumes / poor inspiratory effort (diaphragms high), obese body habitus with large bilateral breast and arm soft-tissue shadows overlying the lower zones and lateral chest, slightly under-penetrated mediastinum (thoracic vertebrae not well seen through the heart). Minimal rotation; costophrenic angles included but the right one is obscured by soft tissue. No cropping of apices.

abnormalities.finding: Cardiomegaly - enlarged cardiac silhouette, cardiothoracic ratio approximately 0.63 (heart ~380 px vs inner thoracic width ~600 px), partly accentuated by low lung volumes
Widened / prominent upper mediastinum with unfolded, tortuous thoracic aorta and prominent aortic knob
Prominent bilateral hila with increased perihilar vascular markings, suggesting pulmonary vascular congestion (no frank interstitial or alveolar oedema)
Low lung volumes with elevated hemidiaphragms (poor inspiration / obesity), crowding of basal vessels
Right costophrenic angle not clearly visualised, possibly blunted - obscured by overlying breast/chest-wall soft tissue; small right effusion cannot be excluded
Large gastric air bubble beneath the left hemidiaphragm (subdiaphragmatic)
Obese body habitus with large bilateral breast shadows and arm soft tissue overlying the lower zones and lateral thorax

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），吸氣不足、肺容積偏低，體型肥胖，雙側乳房及上臂軟組織陰影重疊於下肺野與側胸壁，縱膈穿透稍嫌不足。心影明顯擴大，心胸比約0.63，上縱膈增寬併胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出，雙側肺門陰影增粗，疑肺血管鬱血，但未見明確間質或肺泡性肺水腫。雙肺上野清晰，未見肺實質實變、結節或氣胸；右側肋膈角因軟組織重疊顯示不清、疑似鈍化，無法排除少量肋膜積液，左側肋膈角尚可，左橫膈下見較大胃泡。未見任何管路、導線、心律調節器或人工裝置；骨骼未見明顯骨折或破壞性病灶。
